{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./color.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# LSF -> Flux translation (best-effort):
#   #BSUB -nnodes 600  -> -N 600
#   jsrun: -n3600      -> -n 3600 (total ranks)
#   jsrun: -g1         -> request 1 GPU per resource set; total GPUs likely 600
#   #BSUB -W 10        -> -t 10m
#
# NOTE: LSF -P CSC275MCCLURE not translated.
# Performance/ops implication: accounting/charging may not be applied as intended; site may require project/account out-of-band.
#
# NOTE: LSF -J COLOR not translated.
# Performance/ops implication: job identification may be less convenient; runtime performance unaffected.
#
# NOTE: LSF -o color-3600g.o%J uses %J expansion (jobid) which Flux does not provide portably.
# Performance implication: none; operational implication: logs may overwrite unless you generate unique filenames.
#
# NOTE: Commented LSF -env "...,JOB_FEATURE=NVME" not translated.
# Performance implication: if NVME-local storage was required for I/O performance, omission may reduce performance.

NODES=600
RANKS=3600
GPUS_PER_RS=1
# With jsrun -r6 (6 resource sets per node) and -g1 per RS => 6 GPUs per node.
# Total GPUs = NODES * 6
TOTAL_GPUS=$((NODES * 6))

JOBID=$(flux batch -N ${NODES} -n ${RANKS} -g ${TOTAL_GPUS} -t 10m --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  date

  module load gcc cuda

  export LBPM_WIA_DIR=$HOME/summit/build/LBPM-WIA/tests

  cd /gpfs/alpinetds/csc275/scratch/mcclurej/SCALING/WEAK/3600p || exit 1

  # Keep jsrun since this is intended for Summit-like systems.
  # Run within the allocation; request per-rank cores similar to jsrun -c1.
  flux run -n ${RANKS} -c 1 -g ${TOTAL_GPUS} \
    jsrun -n3600 -r6 -g1 -c1 -brs --smpiargs="-gpu" $LBPM_WIA_DIR/TestCommD3Q19

  exit 0
fi
"
}
